title: At the Hollow Throne (the game's actual climax) the four 'real' endings are gated behind requirements ('three holds rested', 'Ironbound oil', 'the Vale's crown', or Watch/Church/Companies trust plus the Founding Ledger) that are never disclosed until you are standing in the room itself, hundreds of turns and half a continent away from where they'd need to be arranged. Worse, the Act 1 resolution the game itself scores highest and has every companion approve of ('give back the crown and speak the verses') permanently consumes the exact 'Vale's crown' item that the 'sit in it' ending later requires, with zero warning at the time that it would matter again at the very end of the game.
